# Faraday Co. — exclusive Peimar agent in Iraq

> Faraday Co. is the exclusive agent of Peimar, the Italian photovoltaic brand founded in 2007, in Iraq. From its office on Qasmlu Street, Sulaymaniyah 46001, Iraq, Faraday supplies Peimar solar modules, on-grid and hybrid inverters, storage batteries and accessories, designs systems with the climate data of each city and installs them on roofs and on the ground. Open Saturday to Thursday 08:00–17:00, closed Friday. Phone and WhatsApp +964 773 698 9694, email info@faradayiq.com. The site is published in English (https://faradayiq.com/), Arabic (https://faradayiq.com/ar/) and Kurdish Sorani (https://faradayiq.com/ku/).

Key facts:

- Peimar module warranty: S Series (made in Italy) 30-year product and 30-year linear power warranty; OR Series and DR Series 25-year product and 30-year linear power warranty. Peimar products are covered by a QBE Insurance Group policy against third-party damage caused by product defects. Peimar storage batteries carry a 10-year warranty.
- Peimar OR…MNDB modules (N-type TOPCon, bifacial, double glass) list a power temperature coefficient of −0.29 %/°C; the mono and poly modules of the Revamping Line list −0.37 and −0.39 %/°C.
- Solar yield figures come from PVGIS v5.3 (PVGIS © European Union, 2001–2026): 1 kWp of crystalline silicon modules, free-standing, at the optimal tilt and azimuth, 14% system losses, PVGIS-SARAH3 radiation and ERA5 temperatures, retrieved 2026-11-20.
- Peimar sizing module used on the city pages: OR10H610MNDB, 610 W, 2278 × 1134 × 30 mm, 23.61% efficiency.

## Products

- [Products](https://faradayiq.com/products/): the full Peimar range Faraday supplies in Iraq, with datasheets.
- [Photovoltaic modules](https://faradayiq.com/products/modules/): 7 Peimar module series (S, OR and DR), 205–735 W, up to 23.63% efficiency.
- [Hybrid inverters & storage](https://faradayiq.com/products/hybrid/): 8 hybrid inverter families from 3 to 30 kW, single- and three-phase, with Peimar LFP batteries from 3.8 to 47.9 kWh.
- [On-grid inverters](https://faradayiq.com/products/on-grid/): 12 single- and three-phase inverter families from 1 to 125 kW.
- [Microinverters](https://faradayiq.com/products/micro/): PSI-X1P MIC microinverters, 800 and 1000 W.
- [Accessories](https://faradayiq.com/products/accessories/): meters, Wi-Fi and LAN dongles, a data hub, power optimizers, EV chargers, EPS boxes and electrical panels.

## Tools

- [Faraday Designer](https://faradayiq.com/designer/): free PV string designer, no login. Checks string voltages at the city's design temperatures, current per MPPT and the power ratio with the rules of Peimar's installer tool, and estimates yearly energy with PVGIS data for 22 Iraqi cities.

## Solar data for Iraqi cities

- [Solar yield across Iraq](https://faradayiq.com/solar/): annual yield per kWp, in-plane irradiation, optimal tilt and azimuth and string design temperatures (coldest / typical summer / hottest cell, °C) for 22 cities, north to south.
- [Zakho](https://faradayiq.com/solar/zakho/): 1,525.6 kWh/kWp a year, optimal tilt 32°, design temperatures −10 / 54 / 74 °C (Duhok Governorate).
